target.title: fix(models): preserve custom provider tool support
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Custom provider models can declare `models.providers.<provider>.models[].compat.supportsTools=true`, but that metadata was not preserved through runtime/static model conversion consistently. The result is that a schema-valid custom OpenAI-compatible model can be treated as `capabilities=none`, causing OpenClaw to filter tools and report tool calls like `exec` as unavailable.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime should honor the existing valid `compat.supportsTools` model metadata instead of requiring an invalid top-level config key. This keeps custom `openai-completions` providers aligned with built-in provider behavior.

## User Impact

Users can register custom tool-capable OpenAI-compatible models under `models.providers` and have OpenClaw keep tools available at runtime when `compat.supportsTools=true` is configured.

## Evidence

Behavior or issue addressed:
- A custom `openai-completions` model configured with `compat.supportsTools=true` should resolve as tool-capable.
- OpenAI Chat Completions payload construction should keep tools in the payload for that resolved model.
- Static provider catalog conversion should preserve `compat`, `mediaInput`, and merged provider/model `params`.

Exact checks run after this patch:
- `git diff --check`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`

Evidence after fix:
```text
Checking formatting...

All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 254ms on 4 files using 8 threads.
```

Targeted regression tests added:
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts`: custom provider model `compat.supportsTools=true` resolves as tool-capable through `supportsModelTools(model)`.
- `src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`: OpenAI completions payload keeps the `exec` tool when model compat sets `supportsTools=true`.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts`: static catalog model conversion preserves `compat`, `mediaInput`, and merged `params`.

Verification caveat:
- Local Vitest execution in this worktree did not complete within a sane window after repeated Rolldown/Vitest startup output, so I stopped the process rather than claim a false pass. Formatting and diff checks passed locally; CI should run the focused test files cleanly in the normal environment.
